entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-17
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Projecting a JSON-mapped complex property with AsNoTrackingWithIdentityResolution throws InvalidCastException #39322
  • Complete `FirstWithoutOrderByAndFilterWarning` coverage for subqueries #39310
    Backlog
  • Precompiled queries reconstruct nullable-long coalesce with nullable result in anonymous projection #39309
    12.0-preview1
  • Precompiled queries evaluate guarded Nullable<T>.Value during design-time parameter extraction #39308
    12.0-preview1

Closed

  • efcore/NativeAOT: precompile queries throws UnreachableException exception. #35494
    12.0-preview1
  • precompile queries throws UnreachableException exception. #37365
    12.0-preview1

PullRequests

Created

  • Use SYSDATETIME and SYSUTCDATETIME with datetime2 colums #39321
    community-contribution
  • Print shifts and repeated block expressions correctly in ExpressionPrinter #39320
    community-contribution
  • Use the invariant culture for small and unsigned integer literals in CSharpHelper #39319
    community-contribution
  • Don’t scaffold string concatenation defaults as a single string literal #39318
    community-contribution
  • Fix GetOrdinal for duplicate column names and repeated case-insensitive lookups #39317
    community-contribution
  • Escape the LIKE escape character for char parameters in StartsWith/EndsWith/Contains #39316
    community-contribution
  • [release/11.0] Don't derive NULLIF nullability from its first argument #39315
  • Preserve nonnullable coalesce results in precompiled queries #39314
  • Preserve implicit conversions during query precompilation #39313
    area-harness
  • Handle implicit numeric literal conversions in query precompilation #39312
    area-harness
  • Support required-member DTO initializers in query precompilation #39311
    area-harness
  • Fix scalar ExecuteUpdate setter query precompilation #39307
  • Fix query precompilation for captured object properties #39305
    area-harness

Updated

  • Translate grouping aggregates as window functions behind an opt-in #39240
    community-contribution
  • Fix query precompiler rejecting ThenInclude sources #39297
  • Fix SQL Server split-query projections of primitive JSON collections #39294
    area-harness
  • Fix connection cancellation notifications to interceptors #39293
  • Support unqualified class constants in query precompilation #39298
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/11.0' => 'main' #39279
  • Fix nullable value comparer type arguments in compiled models #39292
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0' => 'release/10.0' #39266
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'release/11.0' #39301
  • Correct EF Tasks startup guidance and diagnostics #39296
  • [release/11.0] Fix FromSql queries with JSON-mapped complex properties #39295
  • [release/10.0] Fix Azure SQL JSON_VALUE RETURNING over nested OPENJSON projections #39299
  • [release/11.0] Preserve null results from primitive collection element converters #39288
  • Move relational model mapping equality into metadata types #39287
  • Validate and uniquify complex-property column names #39290
    area-harness
